get_frame_from_video: extract a specific frame from a video file using OpenCV with PyAV fallback
update_annotations: filter COCO-style annotation JSON files to keep only images matching a list of video names
get_filename_size_map: load an annotation JSON file and return a map of image filenames to their width and height
get_filenames: extract all unique image filenames from a COCO-style annotation JSON file
is_valid_image: check if an image file at a given path can be opened and converted to RGB
